Price-dependent missingness, all-assigned sensitivity, logical completion ranges and fixed denominators are retained.
Prespecified audience contrasts preserve observational status and do not establish an audience-specific optimal price.
Value and affordability diagnostics are selected with causal restraint, but their correlation pattern is not selected.
Routed imagined use is correctly qualified, but certainty is omitted from selected findings. Suppressed niche rates remain unreported.
